title: Cloudstitch · 구름 위 봉쇄 전초기지
request: 3d에셋으로 구현해줘 웅장하게 만들어줘 리뷰페이지로 검수할수 있게해줘
method: Local authored 3D geometry with vertex-painted matte materials; no paid model generation.

art_direction.feeling: Nostalgic handmade mechanical fantasy, painterly 2D-looking dimensional 3D; magnificent villain stronghold.
art_direction.silhouette: Tall caged central bell tower above asymmetric roof clusters, layered bastions, broad armored floating hull and projecting guarded dock.

deliverables: authored source and reproducible build tools under tools/enemy-base/
actual GLB renders, structure verification, browser verification, manifest and handoff

asset_contract.units: relative authored design units; engine scale undecided
asset_contract.geometry: complete three dimensional static mesh, including rear and underside; not a projected moodboard
asset_contract.rendering: vertex-painted base colors in GLB; additional toon shading and outline in review runtime
asset_contract.animation: static geometry; review camera rotation is not asset animation

review_contract: local review notes and JSON export
limits: not engine performance or gameplay balance approval
image equipment counts are not system specifications
preservation: New owned namespace only; moodboards, other assets and shared source remain unchanged.
